screen_contract.scanner: Run the exact qualified scratch rule once over each frozen Java snapshot in order, retain raw SARIF and target reports only in the isolated artifact directory, and require exact rule, CWE-918, target, Semgrep version, scratch-configuration digest, complete-or-empty status, and provenance validation.
screen_contract.eligibility: Using only canonical rule metadata and physical locations, accept Java:ssrf results from the exact qualified rule, then perform stable inclusive-transitive path-and-range issue-group deduplication across the two distinct subject identities.
screen_contract.recalculation: Add only the new Java compatible-result and deduplicated-group counts to the frozen base; cap every family at 20; require exactly 40 total packet identities and at least one identity from each Python, TypeScript, Java, and Ruby family. Because frozen Ruby remains zero in this gate, packet feasibility must remain false and no packet may be constructed.

routing.java_groups_positive: Record Java scanner-cell recovery and Ruby source scarcity as the smallest next separately gated source-acquisition prerequisite.
routing.java_groups_zero: Record Java and Ruby source scarcity as the smallest next separately gated source-acquisition prerequisite.

screen_contract.result_rule: Persist only aggregate total Java result/group counts, combined family and mechanism counts, capped capacity, contributing-family count, feasibility false, raw-artifact-set digest, and routing. Do not persist normalized candidate or issue-group identities in result evidence or disclose subject-level counts, paths, rules beyond the already-frozen rule identity, symbols, excerpts, or source.

sequence: Verify immutable bindings, exact snapshots, and absence.
Freeze the copied scratch rule and runtime bindings.
Run exactly two ordered scratch-rule scans with no retry.
Reproduce aggregate Java groups and combined capacity, persist one aggregate artifact and result, verify boundaries, and stop.
